issue.title: CapturePanelSwitchHostedTests caret round-trip assertion fails on macOS CI (selection affinity differs)
issue.description:
Repo: bob-mac-capture (linked). Proposing bead: bob-cli-ab landing audit (not a child
proposal); the defect is not caused by bob-cli-ab.

`CapturePanelSwitchHostedTests.testSwitchAwayAndBackPreservesDraftCaretTemplateAndError`
fails at `Tests/BobMacCaptureTests/CapturePanelSwitchHostedTests.swift:69` on every
macOS 26 CI run since it was added by b47f28b ("test(mac-capture): close out
panel-switch verification", the bob-cli-a8 land closeout, which ran with the Mac
offline so hosted tests were never run before landing).

Failure (identical in each run):

    XCTAssertEqual failed: ("AttributedTextSelection(... insertionPoint(Index(_value: 10[utf8], ...)),
    typingAttributes: .implicit, affinity: .upstream)") is not equal to
    ("AttributedTextSelection(... insertionPoint(Index(_value: 10[utf8]C, ...)),
    typingAttributes: .implicit, affinity: .automatic)")

The caret offset round-trips correctly (UTF-8 index 10 both sides); the assertion
compares the whole SwiftUI `AttributedTextSelection`, whose `affinity` (upstream vs
automatic) and index-character flag differ after the switch-away/back round trip.
Likely fix: assert the restored caret offset (and selection range) rather than
structural equality of `AttributedTextSelection`, or normalize affinity before
comparing; confirm on macOS CI that the production restore path really puts the caret
at offset 10. Do not weaken the draft/template/error preservation checks.

Runs: 39515287077 (b47f28b), 39530493888 (3653661), 39617467830 (d73d943).
Related but distinct baseline Mac failures: bob-cli-ad, bob-cli-ae, bob-cli-af,
bob-cli-ag (different tests, root causes).

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Identical assertion failure at line 69 on three consecutive macOS 26 CI runs across different trees (39515287077 at b47f28b, 39530493888 at 3653661, 39617467830 at d73d943); no passing run has been observed since the test was added.

issue.creation_reason: Found during the bob-cli-ab landing audit: this hosted test has failed on every bob-mac-capture macOS CI run since b47f28b added it, and no task tracks it, so it keeps the Test step red alongside ad/ae/af/ag.
